description: STL 3D model viewer for the Cardputer Zero: browse, open and inspect binary or ASCII STL files on the 320x170 screen.

store.summary: Pocket STL 3D viewer: browse, open and inspect models on the Cardputer Zero
store.description:
KanSTL opens STL 3D models on the Cardputer Zero and lets you look at them from every side.

Pick a file from the built-in browser, then rotate and zoom with the keypad. One key cycles
four looks: solid, edges, metallic and wireframe, and auto-rotate turns the model slowly when
you want to see it all round. A small XYZ gizmo keeps you oriented.

Models are read straight from the device: copy STL files over SSH or a USB stick, and the
browser remembers the folder you were in. Binary and ASCII files both work.

No permissions, no network, no background service. Open source, GPL-3.0.

zh-CN.summary: 口袋 STL 3D 模型查看器：在 Cardputer Zero 上浏览、打开、旋转模型
zh-CN.description:
KanSTL 在 Cardputer Zero 上打开 STL 3D 模型，可以从任意角度查看。

从内置文件浏览器选文件，用键盘旋转、缩放。一个键循环四种风格：实心、轮廓、金属、
线框；需要整体观察时可以打开自动旋转。右上角的 XYZ 方向指示帮你判断朝向。

模型直接读设备上的文件：用 SSH 或 U 盘把 STL 拷进来即可，浏览器会记住上次的目录。
二进制与 ASCII 都支持。

不申请权限，不联网，没有后台服务。开源，GPL-3.0。
